# CeminiParlays

> Local CLI for NFL sportsbook parlays. Research only. The operator types the ticket.

Public docs only. No Odds API keys. No wallet addresses.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): install, commands, and the Never list (the product)
- [Canon](docs/canon.md): numbered citable rules (displayed American, SGP, no scrape, no submit, Jev routes but does not compute)
- [Sunday path](docs/SUNDAY.md): 20-minute operator path and Sunday cash rules
- [Roadmap](docs/ROADMAP.md): phases. `--from-ceminidfs` is built (copy the file; this CLI only reads)
- [Grok Bots](docs/GROK-BOTS.md): live Slate and Recap desks in Grok Bot.app. No scrape. No submit
- [Week 1 reproduce](docs/week1/REPRODUCE.md): committed `grade` artifact (2/5, +$26.07)
- `compare` prints the pick'em gap; a fair marginal comes from the model, not the book you bet; weather adjusts a model marginal per side.
- Jev is a discrete epistemic router, never a calculator: it answers typed questions, and Python does every de-vig, matrix projection, copula draw, and Kelly stake.
- Fair value is never circular: the market side de-vigs a book you did not bet (`ref_book_over` / `ref_book_under`).
- The season CLV ledger is the proof: `grade --season-ledger` appends one row per week, and `mean_clv_bps` resolves long before ticket P&L does.

Tips: see [SUPPORT.md](SUPPORT.md). Do not paste wallets here.
